'''Velery''' was the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Viamarr 4]]. It had a population of about one hundred thousand and was located in a heavily forested region of the planet's largest continent in the southern hemisphere. In [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]], it was visited briefly by [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] and members of [[Wraith Squadron]] after they were able to trick the local [[Governor/Legends|governor]] into believing they were [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] loyal to [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]].
